'''''Zimtsterne''''' are German cinnamon cookies often eaten for the advent season.

==Ingredients==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]
* 300 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 350 g ground [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]] or [[Cookbook:Hazelnut|hazelnuts]]
* A little grated [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] [[Cookbook:Zest|zest]]

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the egg whites until creamy.
# Sift in powdered sugar, and mix into egg whites.
# Set aside almost a third of the resulting mass for casting.
# Stir in the remaining mass of cinnamon and almonds, or hazelnuts and lemon zest, and knead into a dough.
# Roll out the dough, cut out star shapes and place on the greased baking sheet.
# Mix the remaining stiff egg white with rum until a glaze mass forms.
# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] the cinnamon stars with glaze.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a preheated [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 160°C for about 20 minutes.
